title: slb350/octoroute
summary: Smart HTTP router for local LLMs (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp). Rule-based + LLM-powered routing, health checks, load   balancing, Prometheus metrics. Rust-native, zero-overhead.

title: slb350/open-agent-sdk-rust
summary: Rust SDK for building AI agents with local OpenAI-compatible servers (LMStudio, Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM). Features streaming, tools, hooks, retry logic, and comprehensive examples.

title: hrabanazviking/RuneForgeAI-Project-Aesir
summary: Bare-metal Mojo inference engine designed for local sovereignty. Features zero-copy GGUF parsing, PagedAttention KV caching, and a stateless sampler. Optimized for consumer hardware, it eliminates cloud dependency and bloat to deliver high-performance, private AI directly on the edge.

title: whiteball-shiro/blue-whale-agent
summary: 大肥鱼：透明置顶桌面小鲸鱼，显示 LLM 余额，支持 Codex/本地/云端对话、本地委派分流、文件处理与本地生图。不绑定特定模型，可接任意 OpenAI 兼容接口。

title: KazKozDev/WebOperator
summary: Local-first AI browser agent and MCP server for Chrome — runs on Ollama or any cloud model. Open-source alternative to OpenAI Operator.

title: azerozero/grob
summary: LLM proxy with built-in DLP and regulatory compliance. Redacts secrets before they reach the API. EU AI Act, GDPR, HDS/PCI DSS ready. Multi-provider failover, live TUI, virtual keys, fan-out. 6 MB, zero deps. Rust.

title: lidge-jun/opencodex
summary: Universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex & Claude Code — use any LLM (Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Ollama…) with Codex CLI, App, SDK, and Claude Code

title: hoornet/home-mind
summary: OSS AI memory layer for Home Assistant (AGPL). The conversation server inside the Nives addon was forked from this project — they're independent now.

title: vicquick/nobrainr
summary: Persistent memory and knowledge graph for AI agents via MCP — PostgreSQL + pgvector + Ollama

title: dovvnloading/Graphlink
summary: A local-first, graph-based AI workspace. Branch any conversation across a visual canvas instead of one scrolling thread, attach nodes that research the web, run Python, and chart results, then hand multi-step work to a budgeted, fully undoable agent. Works with local (Ollama, llama.cpp) and hosted models.

title: browseros-ai/BrowserOS
summary: 🌐 The open-source Agentic browser; alternative to ChatGPT Atlas, Perplexity Comet, Dia.

title: KinSushi/claude-local-nexus
summary: Plateforme locale d'orchestration IA – Dockerisée, souveraine, reproductible. Claude Code, Ollama, LiteLLM, routeurs adaptatifs, cache Redis, PostgreSQL, Langfuse. Modèles locaux & cloud unifiés.

title: AmirmasoudCS/paper-scout
summary: Agentic pipeline that searches arXiv, Semantic Scholar, and Hugging Face Papers, then produces a report with future work ideas grounded in each paper's own Limitations and Future Work sections, plus a clearly labeled inferred tier for papers without one. Runs fully locally through Ollama.

title: ypollak2/llm-router
summary: Universal LLM router for AI coding tools. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot and more. Free-first fallback chain cuts costs 35-80%.

title: MacNite/NutriCore
summary: Privacy-first, self-hosted nutrition tracker. Log meals, recipes and weight with full data provenance — no ads, analytics or subscriptions. TypeScript/Next.js PWA + PostgreSQL, Open Food Facts integration, optional local AI food search via Ollama, and admin-invite-only accounts. Docker-deployable, i18n (EN/DE).

title: naveen-ramalingam/universal-claude-code-manager
summary: Configure and launch Claude Code with any Anthropic-compatible API gateway (Z.AI/GLM, OpenRouter, LiteLLM, local gateways) with zero configuration.

title: devkdas/hush-companion
summary: A calm, voice-first AI companion for thinking out loud.

title: luceinaltis/poieo
summary: An autonomous task board: write down the work you want done, and the models on your own machine keep it running around the clock.
